params._beneficiary: The beneficiary who may delegate token voting power
params._token: The IERC20 token representing the governance token

devdoc.title: Gov Token Escrow

balance().notice: Get the token balance of the escrow

delegate(address).notice: Delegates voting power of the underlying xINV.

onDeposit().notice: Function called by market on deposit. Function is empty for this escrow.

pay(address,uint256).notice: Transfers the associated ERC20 token to a recipient.

userdoc.notice: Collateral is stored in unique escrow contracts for every user and every market. This specific escrow is meant as an example of how an escrow can be implemented that allows depositors to delegate votes with their collateral, unlike pooled deposit protocols.
